facts.value: The University Computing Centre (HRZ) provides students with the necessary IT for their studies (Goethe Card, HRZ Account, student email address, etc.). It also offers advice and support for technical problems.
The telephone hotline of Goethe University helps with questions related to applications, semester dates, re-registration, change of subject, double studies, leave of absence, and exmatriculation.
The Student Secretariat assists with inquiries regarding applications, semester dates, re-registration, change of subject, double studies, leave of absence, and exmatriculation.
The Central Student Advising service helps with questions related to applications, semester dates, re-registration, change of subject, double studies, leave of absence, and exmatriculation.
International Student Services provide information on topics such as residency permits, German courses, financing, studying successfully, careers, and more. They also offer advice and support.
The Student Services supports students in social and economic matters.

The Student Services aim to ensure that students at universities find the necessary infrastructure for successful studies in areas of educational funding, student housing, canteens, cafeterias, and counseling and support services.
